programme_facts.value: Level B2 (CEFR) or equivalent in written and spoken English and German. Honours undergraduate degree (Level 8 NFQ or equivalent) at 2.1 or higher (or equivalent), with a major/minor specialization in Linguistics, German, English, Journalism or related fields.

MA-level degree (Level 9 NFQ or equivalent) in Applied Linguistics/Sociolinguistics, Journalism, Sociology/Social Sciences or related fields, openness to interdisciplinary methods and some experience in qualitative and quantitative methods, some knowledge of/experience in discourse analysis and/or linguistic corpus analysis.
Include a cover letter (max. 1000 words), a curriculum vitae, a writing sample, contact details of two academic referees, and transcripts of university-level grades.
Interviews for the position will be held online in September 2026.
